dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual geometric narrowing from the wide mid-body section toward the posterior peduncle, ending in a sharp point at the frame boundary.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Distinct bilateral indentation at the cervical region (neck), followed by smooth, convex lateral margins along the primary torso.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mid-range light grey to slate grey; uniform across the dorsal plane with minimal specular highlights.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse dark-pixel clusters distributed primarily along the mid-dorsal axis and toward the posterior region.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient slopes between the lighter primary skin tone and the darker mottled patches.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced cervical constriction creating a visible 'neck' separation between the head and the thoracic mass.
